description:
quality/comment-cleanup-scope.json pins 19 whole-file notices by blob digest. 17 of them (the EULA, NOTICE and PATCHES files under external selectors) already fail closed in the required comment-policy gate (scripts/check_comment_policy.py:222 raises "protected external notice blob changed").

The gap is the two non-external pins, LICENSE and COPYRIGHT.md. A PR that edits COPYRIGHT.md without updating its pin passes transition mode. Once it is on the base, every later run fails with "notice COPYRIGHT.md blob digest does not match immutable base" (scripts/check_comment_cleanup_scope.py:358), so one unguarded edit breaks every following PR.

Add a check to the required comment-policy gate that fails a PR which changes a non-external pinned notice without updating its pin in the same PR.

PR #2829 does not meet this. Its SCOPE008 check runs only in Make targets, not in required CI. It breaks two existing tests: tests/unit/test_make_timing.py::test_timed_targets_are_prerequisite_free_single_command_recipes and tests/unit/test_ledger_coverage.py::test_ledger_lists_every_pre_commit_hook. Its message for external notices cannot pass, because external pins are read from the base (see comment-policy-digest-and-base-exception-catch22-20261008).
